# Legacy DOC fixtures

These binary `.doc` files are copied from the `word-extractor` 1.0.4 test
corpus at commit `18ddff5173046131a8ff6ee5321a91a5ea0e3010`:

- `table.doc` is upstream `test03.doc` (a one-page table).
- `unicode-header-footer.doc` is upstream `test04.doc` (Unicode body,
  header, and footer text).
- `notes.doc` is upstream `test13.doc` (footnote and endnote text).
- `textboxes.doc` is upstream `test16.doc` (body and header text boxes).

Upstream source: https://github.com/morungos/node-word-extractor/tree/1.0.4/__tests__/data

The fixtures are redistributed under the MIT license in
`UPSTREAM_LICENSE.txt`.
